name: Can I install a new countertop on an existing vanity base?
description: Often, yes, a new countertop can be installed on an existing vanity base if it's structurally sound; Hometelligent Inc. assesses this during consultation.

mainEntity.name: Can I install a new countertop on an existing vanity base?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many cases, you can install a new countertop on an existing vanity base, provided the base is structurally sound, level, and in good condition. Hometelligent Inc. assesses the integrity of your current vanity during the initial consultation to ensure it can support the weight of a new countertop, especially if you're upgrading to a heavier material like stone. This approach can be a cost-effective way to update your bathroom, but a thorough inspection is crucial to prevent future issues. We will advise if the existing base requires reinforcement or replacement.
